test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electronic Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Match the following designations of sheets with their respective trimmed sizes in length and breadth. 

 
 

 **Designation**
 **Trimmed Size**
 
 

 A) A0
 P) 297 × 420
 
 

 B) A1
 Q) 420 × 594 
 
 

 C) A2
 R) 594 × 841
 
 

 D) A3
 S) 841 × 1189
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

 
• **A0 (S - 841 × 1189 mm):** The A0 sheet has the largest size in the series and is defined as having an area of exactly 1 square meter. Its dimensions are 841 mm in breadth and 1189 mm in length. This matches with "S".
 
• **A1 (R - 594 × 841 mm):** A1 is derived by halving A0 along its longer side, resulting in dimensions of 594 mm × 841 mm. This corresponds with "R".
 
• **A2 (Q - 420 × 594 mm):** A2 is obtained by halving A1 along its longer side, with dimensions of 420 mm × 594 mm. This matches with "Q".
 
• **A3 (P - 297 × 420 mm):** A3 is derived by halving A2 along its longer side, resulting in dimensions of 297 mm × 420 mm. This matches with "P".

Thus, the correct matching is:

 
• A - S (841 × 1189 mm)
 
• B - R (594 × 841 mm)
 
• C - Q (420 × 594 mm)
 
• D - P (297 × 420 mm)
